title: Vishal:
title_q: “What It Means to Be Part of the Kiva Community”
headline: Kiva lenders stay, even when it's hard. Vishal tells two stories and says thank you.
story: Brit asked for this one first. It goes into a Kiva donation campaign. Vishal answers “What does it mean to be part of the Kiva community?” with two stories.

First, when partners in Lebanon could not repay, most lenders said: “this is why we are on Kiva.” Second, a student lender with little money who still found a way to give, and never took it back. It ends on him, touched: “that's how most of our community is.” It is a thank-you to everyday lenders, warm and hopeful.
do: Open on frame 1 on “Our lending community is the best.”
Cut his stutters cleanly. Cover each cut with B-roll.
Name super after the hook, about 0:06–0:09.
Keep the ending line whole. Do not cut it.
Put “Thanks for doing what you do” at the very end, before the end card.
dont: Don't make it about Kiva the institution, how a loan works, or Vishal himself.
Do not use P1000927 (Kiva in Schools / Dave Smith). It is its own video.
No “Nice”, “That's a great story” or any crew talk.
No name plate, logo or fade at 0:00.
Do not cut to the indoor P1000800 picture (white shirt). Sound only, if at all.
